description: Source code for MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) operations related to automatic mixed precision (AMP) in PyTorch, including functions for non-finite check, unscale, and scale update on MPS tensors.

methods.name: _amp_non_finite_check_and_unscale_mps_single_impl
methods.description: Performs non-finite check and unscale operation on a single MPS tensor.

methods.name: _amp_update_scale_mps_impl
methods.description: Updates the scale factor for AMP on MPS tensors.

methods.name: getAmpCPLState
methods.description: Retrieves Metal pipeline state and function for a given function name.

methods.name: _amp_foreach_non_finite_check_and_unscale_mps_

methods.name: _amp_update_scale_mps_
